title: Automated Multi-Class Hate Speech Detection in Social Media Text Using Fine-Tuned BERT Models: experiment code and results
description: Code, split definition, configurations, per-run metrics and predictions for a controlled comparison of seven classifiers for three-class hate speech detection on the Davidson et al. corpus. The corpus itself is not redistributed; it is downloaded from the authors' repository and checked by SHA-256.
